summary: Whether you show it or not, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes. Owned, you build things that last and carry real weight and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
body: Whether you show it or not, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes. Owned, you build things that last and carry real weight and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. Able to carry punishing, transformative work; the risk is harshness.
gift: At your best: you build things that last and carry real weight, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes — or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let discipline and limits and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Able to carry punishing, transformative work; the risk is harshness.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you build things that last and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
